in_sanskrit.name: Antu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breath, Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Antu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Antu means 'breath' or 'life'. It is derived from the root word 'an' meaning 'towards' and 'tu' meaning 'breath'. In Hindu mythology, the god of breath is Prana Deva. The name Antu is a reminder of the importance of breath in sustaining life.
